Take a look at the best moments from an enthralling encounter between Liverpool and Manchester United in the 2025/26 season! Arne Slot's Liverpool hosted Ruben Amorim's Manchester United, with the visitors going a goal up early on thanks to Bryan Mbeumo. Cody Gakpo equalised with 15 minutes to go, with a late surge on the cards. However Harry Maguire was the hero of the day, scoring in the 84th minute to seal a huge win for the Red Devils!
